1 cup unbleached all-purpose flour

1 teaspoon salt

3 eggs, beaten

1/2 cup water

Toppings:

1 tablespoon chopped cilantro

1 tablespoon sliced green onions

1 tablespoon sliced roasted peanuts

2.   In a bowl, mix the cooked rice, cornstarch slurry, salt, and sugar.

3.   Allow rice to cool.

4.   Stir in water chestnuts, mushrooms, and leeks.

5.   Pour mixture into a greased 9 inch spring roll pan.   The pan can be greased with a light oil.

6.   To make the roll wrappers, mix flours and salt in a bowl.

7.   Make a well in the center of the mixture and pour in the egg and water.

8.   Stir well to form a dough.

9.   Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

10.   Roll out the dough on a floured surface into very thin circles.

11.   Heat 3 inches of olive oil in a frying pan.

12.   Add the dough circles to the hot oil and fry for 3 to 4 minutes on each side.

13.   Drain on paper towels.

14.   Place one roll of filling on a plate, then place one roll on top.

15.   Add one tablespoon of chopped cilantro and one tablespoon of sliced green onions.

16.   Drizzle with 1 tablespoon soy sauce.
  
17.   Garnish with roasted peanuts.
